title: Radar-Based 3D Human Pose Estimation via Motion-Aware Pose Initialization and Observation-Guided Refinement
abstract: arXiv:2610.27774v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: 3D Human Pose Estimation (3D HPE) is used in indoor environments, such as smart homes, to analyze human movement and monitor human states. Millimeter-wave (mmWave) radar is suitable for this task because it is robust to lighting variations and does not capture images of human appearance. However, radar observations often provide insufficient information about certain body parts or contain overlapping reflections from multiple body parts, limiting accurate 3D joint localization. To address these limitations, we propose the Initialization-to-Refinement Pose Framework (I2R-Pose), comprising two stages: Motion-Aware Pose Initialization and Observation-Guided Refinement. In the first stage, joint-wise features are learned by incorporating temporal relationships across consecutive radar observations and human skeletal structure to compensate for insufficient joint information and estimate an initial 3D pose sequence. translated_title: 基于雷达的3D人体姿态估计：运动感知姿态初始化与观测引导细化
translated_abstract: 3D人体姿态估计（3D HPE）被应用于智能家居等室内环境中，用于分析人体运动并监测人体状态。毫米波雷达非常适合这项任务，因为它对照明变化具有鲁棒性，且不会拍摄人体外观的图像。然而，雷达观测往往无法提供关于某些身体部位的充分信息，或者包含来自多个身体部位的重叠反射，这限制了准确的3D关节定位。为了解决这些局限性，我们提出了初始化到细化姿态框架（I2R-Pose），包含两个阶段：运动感知姿态初始化和观测引导细化。在第一阶段，通过结合连续雷达观测之间的时间关系与人体骨骼结构来学习关节级特征，以补偿关节信息的不足并估计初始的3D姿态序列。在第二阶段，……（摘要原文在此处被截断）
tldr: 该论文提出了I2R-Pose两阶段框架，通过运动感知的姿态初始化（结合时序关系与骨骼结构来补偿关节信息不足）以及观测引导的细化，克服毫米波雷达观测中关节信息缺失和反射重叠的问题，从而提升3D人体姿态估计的准确性。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes I2R-Pose, a two-stage framework that improves mmWave radar-based 3D human pose estimation by using motion-aware pose initialization to compensate for insufficient joint information via temporal relationships and skeletal structure, followed by observation-guided refinement to handle missing and overlapping radar reflections.
